control_flow: avoidWalls: if the left light is below 30 %, look at the left and right obstacle sensors and curve away, or call driveInTheDark; else call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve with left 10 % and right 40 %; else with left 40 % and right 10 %.
No block waits: the functions are called again and again, and the motors are set again every frame.
